questions.question: What do you do?
questions.answer: Structural design, works supervision, building and planning permits, energy audits, energy certificates, solar systems and technical documentation for tenders. We also deliver turnkey solar systems, prefab homes and renovations.

questions.question: How long does it take to design a house?
questions.answer: It depends on the project. A detached house usually takes 4 to 8 weeks, a commercial building can take 2 to 4 months. After the first meeting we give you a precise estimate.

questions.question: Do you also work outside Sicily?
questions.answer: Yes. The firm is based in Messina, but we also take on projects in the rest of Italy. For sites outside the region we arrange the visits and work with local engineers and contractors.

questions.question: Do you charge for a quote?
questions.answer: No, the first meeting and the quote are free. The quote arrives within 48 hours of the site visit; the cost of the work depends on the type of job and how complex it is.

questions.question: Do you handle the paperwork too?
questions.answer: Yes. Permits, CILA, SCIA, land registry filings and dealings with the municipality and other authorities are on us, from start to finish.

questions.question: Do you do energy certificates and audits?
questions.answer: Yes: energy certificates (APE), energy audits under Law 10 and solar system design. We also help you work out which upgrades really improve the energy rating and which incentives you can get.

ape.name: APE
ape.description: Certifies the energy class of the property. It is mandatory to sell or rent a home.

docfa.name: DOCFA
docfa.description: Updates the property at the land registry: new floor plans, changes and registrations.

cila.name: CILA
cila.description: For non-structural extraordinary maintenance, such as new bathrooms, systems or internal partitions.

scia.name: SCIA
scia.full: Certified notice of start of activity
scia.description: For larger works, such as renovations that affect the structural parts of the building.

permit.name: Building permit
permit.description: Required for new buildings, extensions and major renovations.

faq.q: How much does an APE cost?
faq.a: The Energy Performance Certificate starts from {ape}. The final price depends on the size and features of the property and includes the site visit.

faq.q: When do I need a CILA and when a SCIA?
faq.a: A CILA is enough for non-structural extraordinary maintenance, such as bathrooms, systems and partitions. A SCIA is needed for larger works affecting structural parts. After the site visit we tell you which one applies.

faq.q: How much do building permits cost?
faq.a: A CILA starts from {cila}, a SCIA from {scia} and a building permit from {permit}. The final cost depends on the works and any fees due to public offices.

faq.q: Do you handle the paperwork during a renovation too?
faq.a: Yes. We can take care of the practice alone or of the whole job, from design to works management, with a single point of contact.
